app.name: CivicAI Mysuru
app.tagline: Verified waste-collection updates for your ward
app.principle: AI never invents or authorizes a municipal schedule. Every alert comes from a verified municipal notice — and when nothing has been published, we say so plainly.

status.verifiedHelp: Confirmed by an authorized municipal operator against an official source.
status.unverifiedHelp: Reported but not yet confirmed by the municipality. Do not rely on it.

event.conflict: Conflicting notices for this day are under operator review. Showing the most recently verified notice.
event.unverifiedNote: This possible alternative has not been confirmed by the municipality yet.

dashboard.noDisruptionsBody: There are no verified disruption notices for your ward. Your normal collection schedule applies.
dashboard.noServices: No services are registered for this ward yet.
dashboard.askCta: Ask a question about your schedule

notifications.title: Notification Center
notifications.subtitle: Every official alert sent to you. Messages are kept exactly as they were sent.
notifications.emptyBody: When a verified notice affects your ward, it will appear here.
notifications.aiTranslated: AI translation, checked against the official notice. The English text is the official version.
notifications.translationRejected: The translation did not match the official notice, so the official English text is shown.

kind.verified_alternative: Pickup moved to a new day

ask.title: Ask about your schedule
ask.subtitle: Answers come only from verified records for your ward. If the answer isn't on record, we will say so.
ask.placeholder: e.g. When will my garbage be collected this week?
ask.example3: What is my normal collection time?
ask.rejected: The AI answer could not be verified against the records, so the verified information on record is shown instead.

report.title: Report a problem
report.subtitle: Tell the municipality about a missed or delayed collection.
report.descriptionHelp: At least 10 characters. Please don't include personal details of other people.
report.aiDraftNote: Draft written with AI from your notes. Review and edit it — nothing is sent until you press Submit.
report.aiDraftRejected: The AI draft added details you didn't write, so your original text was kept.
report.photoHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 4 MB.
report.photoTooLarge: That photo is larger than 4 MB.
report.photoWrongType: Only JPEG, PNG or WebP photos are accepted.
report.locationHelp: Only stored with this complaint. You can delete it at any time.
report.noComplaintsBody: Complaints you submit will appear here so you can track them.

cat.missedText: Garbage was not picked up from my street on the scheduled day.
cat.binText: The community bin near my house is overflowing and needs to be cleared.
cat.skippedText: The collection vehicle skipped our lane.

onboarding.title: Choose your ward
onboarding.subtitle: We use your ward — not your exact location — to send you alerts that affect you.
onboarding.mapHint: Tap the map where you live, or pick your ward from the list.
onboarding.mapUnavailable: The map is not available right now — please choose your ward from the list.
onboarding.boundaryNotice: Your point is close to a ward boundary. We picked the ward whose centre is nearest — please confirm it is correct.
onboarding.ambiguousNotice: Your point is on the boundary between wards. Please choose your ward below.
onboarding.outsideNotice: That point is outside the wards served in this demo. Please choose your ward from the list.
onboarding.demoBoundaries: Ward boundaries shown here are illustrative demo shapes, not official MCC boundaries.
onboarding.confirmWard: I confirm this is my ward

auth.name: Full name
auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
auth.notConfigured: Sign-in is not configured on this deployment yet (Supabase environment variables are missing).
auth.operatorNote: Municipal operator accounts are issued by the administrator and cannot be created here.
auth.demoAccounts: Demo accounts are listed in the project README.
auth.quickTry: Just looking? Try it in one tap
auth.sidePitch: Know when your garbage will really be collected — only from notices the city has checked.

landing.headline: Know when your garbage will really be collected.
landing.body: When a holiday, breakdown or road closure disrupts collection in Mysuru, CivicAI tells you — but only what the municipality has actually verified.
landing.f1Body: Every notice shows its source, verification status and when it was last verified.
landing.f2Body: If no alternative schedule exists, you're told exactly that — never a guessed time.
landing.f3Body: Translations are checked so dates and times can never change.
landing.step1Body: Holiday, breakdown or road closure: an official checks the notice first.
landing.step2Body: Only people in your ward are told, in English or ಕನ್ನಡ.
landing.step3Title: You know when to put waste out
landing.step3Body: If no new date is announced yet, we say so. No guessing.
landing.tryOperator: Try it as a city operator
landing.previewBody: Pick a situation. The phone shows exactly what a resident would see.

common.somethingWrongBody: This page could not be loaded. Your data is safe — please try again.
common.notFoundBody: The page or record you are looking for does not exist, or you don't have access to it.
common.requestFailed: The request failed. Please try again.

ai.unavailable: AI assistance is temporarily unavailable. Everything else keeps working — alerts and schedules always come from verified records.

home.noNewDate: The city has not announced a new date yet. We will alert you as soon as it does.
home.notConfirmed: The city has not confirmed this change yet. Keep following your usual day for now.
home.nothingScheduled: No pickups in the next two weeks.
home.tapDay: Tap a day to see what is happening
home.allGoodBody: Nothing has changed in your ward. Keep your waste ready on your usual days.
home.askBody: Get answers in English or ಕನ್ನಡ
